eligibilityMatrix.language: Proficiency in spoken and written English.

eligibilityMatrix.spiritual: Demonstrated research aptitude and ministry experience in chosen field.

faq.question: When can I apply?
faq.answer: Applications are open from January 1 to May 15 each year for the June intake. Late applications may be considered subject to seat availability.

faq.question: Are scholarships available?
faq.answer: Yes, GEC offers merit-based and need-based scholarships. Contact admissions for details and eligibility criteria.

faq.question: Are hostel facilities provided?
faq.answer: Yes, GEC provides separate hostel facilities for male and female students with round-the-clock security, dining, and Wi-Fi.

faq.question: What happens after I submit my application?
faq.answer: Our admissions team will acknowledge receipt within 2 business days and contact you to schedule your personal interview.
